featured_reviews.review_text:
Had a really great experience at Golden Ratio Tattoo Studio! The artist was super professional and made the whole process smooth and comfortable. What I loved the most was the detailing—my tattoo turned out so clean, delicate, and exactly how I wanted it.

You can clearly see the precision and skill in the work, especially in the fine lines and overall finish. The studio also maintains great hygiene and has a very calm, welcoming vibe.

Overall, the quality and experience were honestly at par with the best. Definitely recommend if you’re looking for a well-done, detailed tattoo. ✨

featured_reviews.name: Priyaa Nair
featured_reviews.review_text:
The studio vibe is so good, well maintained and hygienic .
Ajit Meticulously curates the design. Modifies and creates the design as per your choice, shows several iterations before  actually tattooing. The colour selection, minute details were done so professionally. Highly experienced, dedicated and talented artist. Completely satisfied with art work done by Ajit. It was my first tattoo and it was impeccable beyond my expectations. Highly recommended. 5 on 5.

featured_reviews.name: Dhiraj Deorukhakar
featured_reviews.review_text: Got my tattoo done recently and the experience was amazing. Ajit was patient, understood my idea perfectly, and suggested improvements that made the design even better. The guy does wonders 💯.

Thank you Ajit.
